h4_clause_analysis.why_unchanged: the registered refutation condition is "another fold has a strictly higher rate for EITHER detector"; the envelope half already triggered it, so no IF evidence can reverse the overall decision

iforest_evidence.metric: mean over 5 seeds of held-out alarm rate at q=0.01

h4_clause_analysis.reading: the envelope count is driven by how OFTEN a bound is crossed; the IF score by how FAR a row lies from the training manifold

predictions_recorded_before_test.fpr_direction: FPR on C-vary is expected to exceed FPR on C-load2M; this is a direction, not a magnitude
predictions_recorded_before_test.fpr_magnitude_warning: the 35.17% held-out alarm rate on the vary fold must NOT be read as a prediction of test FPR on C-vary. The vary fold is a counterfactual in which N-vary training runs are removed. The test model is trained on all four configs including vary; this predicts Phase 7 behavior for a profile absent from training. Seed range 31.03% to 37.07%.
predictions_recorded_before_test.threshold_ownership: the bottom q of full-train scores is owned by normal_varying|vary; benign load dynamics sets the threshold, so recall is expected lowest on milder throughput faults, particularly degrade
predictions_recorded_before_test.dynamics_not_only_level: p95 max|d1| is 401683.8 on varying versus 24943.0 on fixed configs (factor 16.1); the vary fold extrapolates in dynamics as well as level
predictions_recorded_before_test.no_tuning: q, seeds, max_samples, columns and hyperparameters remain registered
